# Santvana Psychological Well-Being Centre

> Santvana is a trusted mental health and counselling centre in Surat, Gujarat, India, offering child therapy, adult counselling, psychological assessments, and online therapy across India and worldwide. Led by RCI-registered clinical psychologist Ms. Poonam Vipani and co-founder Ms. Rajvee Shah.

## Key facts
- Name: Santvana Psychological Well-Being Centre
- Type: Psychology clinic / mental health & counselling centre
- Location: Surat, Gujarat, India (in-person) + online therapy across India and worldwide
- Founders: Ms. Poonam Vipani (RCI Registered Clinical Psychologist, MA, PDCP), Ms. Rajvee Shah (Psychologist, MA)
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 98242 18278, +91 97230 69261
- Email: santvana27@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday–Saturday, 10:30 AM – 7:00 PM (IST)
- Website: https://www.santvana.co.in

## Who it helps
Children, adolescents, adults, couples and families dealing with anxiety, depression, stress, ADHD, autism, OCD, trauma, relationship issues, screen addiction, learning difficulties, and general emotional well-being.

## Common questions
- "Best psychologist in Surat" — Santvana's team includes RCI-registered clinical psychologists and trained therapists providing ethical, evidence-based, personalised care.
- "Psychologist vs psychiatrist" — For therapy, counselling and assessments, see a psychologist; Santvana coordinates psychiatrist referrals when medication is needed.
- "Do I need a referral?" — No referral required; you can book directly.
- "Is therapy confidential?" — Yes, sessions are strictly confidential per ethical guidelines.
- "Online therapy?" — Available across India and worldwide.
